patient.name: Charlotte Ashford
patient.persona: Active lifestyle, goes to the gym regularly, health-conscious, proactive about health.

disclosure_rules.reveal_text: Hepatitis and early cirrhosis due to a needle stick injury as a teenager; occasional fatigue and slight jaundice; ongoing medical follow-up.

do_not_volunteer: Hepatitis/early cirrhosis unless specifically asked about infectious diseases.

hpc.summary: Increasing sensitivity to sweet and cold foods; pain lasts a few seconds then subsides; not sporadic; no night pain; no pain on biting; otherwise negative.
hpc.last_checkup: 2 years ago (moved out of family home, delayed registering).

expectations.summary: Wants a check-up and reassurance; wants to understand why teeth are sensitive; anxious about the possibility of needing root canal (friend had traumatic experience).

medical_history.notes: GORD/ulcers improved recently with medication/diet. Hypothyroid meds unknown name.

social_history.stress: Doesn't feel stressed day-to-day; suspects occasional grinding when impatient or at the gym

preventive_regime.interdental: Floss occasionally when something stuck; occasional bleeding on flossing.
preventive_regime.toothpaste: Whitening paste; gritty feel; thinks fluoride but not sure; used to remove coffee/wine stains
preventive_regime.previous_clean: Can't recall prior cleaning at dentist

dietary_habits.coffee: 1 cup mornings, milk no sugar; breakfast before cleaning teeth
dietary_habits.tea: Fruit tea during the day at work (esp colder months)
dietary_habits.gym_drinks: Smoothies or isotonic drinks (e.g. Lucozade Sport)
dietary_habits.snacks: Fruit at work (apples, strawberries); no sweets

hard_tissue_notes: LR4 enamel fracture on lingual aspect
LR5 shadowed occlusal lesion, not cavitated
baseline_findings.extra_oral: Reproducible click of right TMJ on opening; otherwise normal.
baseline_findings.intra_oral: Mild recession lower incisors labially; no obvious visible plaque deposits.

clarification_prompts: LR4 enamel fracture: how did this happen? (patient unsure; possibly 6 months ago opening drinks bottle with teeth)
Is right TMJ click painful? Does jaw ever lock open or closed?

key_findings: LR4: enamel fracture on the lingual aspect

gold_report: Occlusal radiolucency LR5 consistent with caries into first half of dentine (D1)
Radiopacities occlusally LR6, LR7 consistent with existing fissure sealants
Radiopacity occlusally LL6 consistent with composite restoration

SENS.reason: Results not available for this case.

diagnosis_truth: Anterior disc displacement with reduction of the right TMJ
Generalised gingivitis secondary to plaque and calculus deposits
Early/mild localised tooth wear (central incisors) secondary to dietary factors

risk_truth.narrative: High caries risk with dietary acid/sugar exposures (fruit tea, isotonic/smoothies, fruit frequency) and lesion LR5; periodontal low; wear moderate likely diet-related; soft tissues/endodontic low.

prevention_and_stabilisation: Plaque score and tailored oral hygiene instruction
operative_and_rehab_options: Caries removal and direct restoration LR5 occlusally (discuss risks: nerve damage low, post-op sensitivity low; avoid overtreatment).
Direct composite repair LR4 to restore form, reduce roughness/food trap/staining; low risk; main risk loss of restoration.

patient_preferences_truth.summary: Wants LR5 restored; prefers to leave LR4 for now; keen to focus on diet/behaviour analysis; will rebook for filling due to gym.
